ns2:section.sectionText: Sustainability Metrics and Assessment Techniques: Evaluating Student Sustainability Committee-Funded Projects. This course teaches techniques for evaluating projects/actions aimed at increasing sustainability, such as reducing harmful emissions and other pollution, and conservation of natural resources. We will use a variety of projects funded by the University of Illinois? Student Sustainability Committee (SSC) as case studies to apply analytical frameworks. These projects include the sustainable student farm, solar energy systems, energy-efficiency retrofits of buildings, energy control systems for buildings, LED lighting, water-conservation equipment, and programs to reduce petroleum usage in transportation. No field trip fee.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
